soldier: Head, antennae and the upturned part of the pronotum of the soldier pale yellow, nasus brownish yellow, thoracic and abdominal tergites and legs milky white. Very few hairs on the head and thoracic tergites, the abdominal tergites with more numerous long hairs. Head nearly circular, slightly longer than wide, the sides rounded, the posterior margin projecting in an arc. Nasus almost as long as the head. Mandibles blunt, without a pointed spine. Antennae with 11 to 12 segments, mostly 11; segment 3 about twice as long as segment 2, segment 2 almost equal to or shorter than segment 4 and the shortest of all. Anterior half of the pronotum erect and upturned, neither margin with a distinct incision. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented.
worker: Worker: apical tooth of the left mandible equal to the first marginal tooth, the cutting edges between the marginal teeth straight; apical tooth of the right mandible also equal to the first marginal tooth, the second marginal tooth situated close to the first.
